description_en: Checks the commercial activation status of a product
description_zh: 检查产品的商业化开通状态
kebab_example: aliyun arms check-commercial-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service apm --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckCommercialStatus

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Default value: ap-southeast-1
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The sub-product type. Valid values:

apm: Application Monitoring
rum: Real User Monitoring
prometheus: Managed Service for Prometheus
xtrace: Managed Service for OpenTelemetry

子产品类型：

apm：应用监控

prometheus：可观测监控 Prometheus 版
xtrace：可观测链路 OpenTelemetry 版
parameters.name: service
